claims: daily-series.ts:69-73: the `try/catch` in `isZeroWei` can never catch anything, because the regex already guarantees `BigInt` will parse

judge_reasoning.3830423746: The review explicitly clears the next-day calculation and says a zero row is fine. It never identifies the negative revenue spike that happens when a nonzero prior baseline is followed by a zero row.
judge_reasoning.3830513980: The review says a wallet with past yield can't be read as an empty row. It doesn't consider a full transfer to another tracked wallet that zeroes all four fields, so it misses the unsubtracted prior yield.

1.why: Checked daily-series.ts:66-74: the /^-?\d+$/ regex only matches ASCII digits with an optional minus sign, which BigInt always parses, so the catch really is unreachable. That makes it harmless dead code, a style point rather than a defect.
